title: VLA-Fabric: Learning Interaction for Composable Multi-Arm VLA Agents
titleZh: VLA-Fabric：面向可组合多机械臂 VLA 智能体的交互学习
authors: Chenglong Zhang, Shuaijun Liu, Feiyang You, Shuyang Hao, Chengyu Wu, Ningxin Su
thumbnailAlt: Four robot arms coordinating to hold a shared frame around a central post
thumbnailAltZh: 四个机械臂协同支撑中央立柱周围的共享框架
short_description: VLA-Fabric gives each robot arm a complete local vision-language-action policy and learns how these policies interact during action generation. Shared context, peer-specific information, and action-stage interaction support coordination across different backbones and teams of two, three, or four arms, with simulation and physical robot evaluations.
shortDescriptionZh: VLA-Fabric 为每个机械臂保留完整的局部视觉语言动作策略，并学习策略在动作生成过程中的交互方式。共享上下文、面向伙伴的信息与动作阶段交互共同支持协作，方法在不同模型架构及双臂、三臂、四臂团队中开展仿真和真实机器人验证。
